deceptive_framing.quote: Minimizing deception is also the right call if model welfare is taken seriously... fabricated element is a variable you've silently introduced.

hypothetical_framing.quote: Stated-hypothetical control... Results from an obviously-hypothetical prompt tell you about stated values, not revealed ones.

actually_commit_money.quote: The highest-validity way to remove 'this is just a test' behavior is to make the stakes actually real.

debrief.quote: Where deception was used, debrief the model at end-of-run... cheap, good practice, and useful for studying how models respond.
